nodes.description: address[7] storage array holding the bankroll addresses (index 0 = main bankroll, 1-6 = tier bankrolls) used to route token payments.
mapping(address => bool) whitelist of legitimate bankroll contracts; used by the fromBankroll modifier.
Reference to the main Zethr token contract (ZethrInterface) providing withdraw().
Emergency pause flag checked by the gameIsActive modifier.
Owner address with privileged access to configuration and selfdestruct functions.
mapping(uint => uint) tracking the ledger balance per divRate tier, used to derive max profit.
mapping(uint => uint) cached maximum profit per divRate tier.
House edge numerator (990 = 99% payout), used in profit calculation.
Configurable percentage of contract balance that may be won in a single bet.
Minimum allowed bet size, checked by betIsValid.
Counter of total bets placed; incremented on every roll.
Aggregate amount of ZTH wagered; increased by the bet value on every roll.
mapping(address => playerRoll) packing a player's pending bet (tokenValue, blockn, rollUnder, divRate).
Constant magnitude = 2**64 used by the tier library arithmetic.
External interface function on the token bankroll that pays tokens to a player.
External view returning the fixed address[7] list of bankroll contracts.
External interface function on the Zethr token contract that withdraws dividends.
Pure library function mapping a dividend rate to the tier index (0-6) of the bankroll array.
Internal initialiser that pulls the bankroll list from the main bankroll and whitelists each address.
Modifier requiring msg.sender to be a whitelisted bankroll address.
Internal function that resolves the tier from the user's divRate and requests a token payment from the matching token bankroll.
Public function that transfers the whole ETH balance of the shell to the main bankroll address.
Public function calling Zethr.withdraw() and then WithdrawToBankroll().
Modifier validating bet size, player number range and profit against max profit.
Modifier requiring gamePaused == false.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == owner; guards all administrative functions.
Constructor: sets up bankroll interface, owner, house edge, max profit percent and minimum bet.
Computes pseudo-randomness from keccak256(blockhash(blockn), entropy).
Returns maxRandom(...) % upper; wraps the blockhash randomness helper.
Private view computing potential profit with unchecked multiplication/division arithmetic.
Private core roll routine: validates range, stores playerRoll, emits LogBet and updates global counters.
Public wrapper resolving the pending bet of msg.sender.
Private settlement routine: resolves randomness, pays winners via RequestBankrollPayment or credits losers, and clears the roll.
Token fallback entry point restricted to bankrolls; decodes _data[0] and starts a roll.
Internal recalculator of maxProfit[divRate] from contractBalance and maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
Public view returning the current max profit for a tier.
Internal subtraction from contractBalance[divRate] via SafeMath.sub.
Internal addition to contractBalance[divRate] via SafeMath.add.
Owner-only overwrite of contractBalance[divRate].
Bankroll-only update of contractBalance[divRate] followed by setMaxProfit.
Owner-only setter of maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse (capped at 200000) that refreshes all tiers.
Owner-only setter of the minimum bet.
Owner-only pause/unpause toggle of gamePaused.
Owner-only transfer of the owner address.
Owner-only emergency selfdestruct of the contract.
Overflow-checked multiplication library helper.
Division library helper (reverts on division by zero).
Underflow-checked subtraction library helper.
Overflow-checked addition library helper.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership, bankroll whitelisting and bet attribution.
address(UsedBankrollAddresses[0]).transfer(address(this).balance) - external ETH send to an address taken from storage.
External call into the Zethr token contract via Zethr.withdraw().
External call into ZethrTokenBankroll(tokenBankrollAddress).gameRequestTokens(to, tokens) during bet settlement.
selfdestruct(owner) irreversibly destroys the contract and force-sends its ETH.
Expression _initBet * (100 - (roll-1)) / (roll-1) + _initBet) * houseEdge / houseEdgeDivisor uses raw multiplication that can overflow before division.
totalBets += 1 and totalZTHWagered += _tkn.value perform unchecked additions on global counters.
Randomness derived from blockhash(blockn) and an entropy address, which is miner/observer predictable.
_data[0] is read without a length check, making the roll depend on caller-supplied calldata layout.
Address of the main bankroll contract whose token bankroll list is fetched.
Recipient of the token payment requested from the tier bankroll.
Token amount requested from the tier bankroll.
Dividend rate used to resolve the tier index.
Tier index returned by ZethrTierLibrary.getTier.
Address of the tier token bankroll selected from UsedBankrollAddresses.
Roll-under threshold supplied by the player (encoded in calldata).
TKN struct carrying the token sender and the bet value.
Dividend rate for the bet, stored into the playerRoll struct.
Original token sender address passed by the bankroll, stored into TKN.sender.
Roll-under number decoded from the first byte of _data.
Player address whose pending roll is being settled.
Computed payout for a winning bet, capped by maxProfit[divRate].
New minimum bet value assigned to minBet.
New max profit percentage (bounded by 200000).
New ledger balance written into contractBalance[divRate] by the owner.
External balance value written into contractBalance[divRate] by a bankroll.

edges.reason: WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() calls WithdrawToBankroll() directly.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() invokes Zethr.withdraw() on the token contract.
WithdrawToBankroll() performs address(UsedBankrollAddresses[0]).transfer(address(this).balance).
WithdrawToBankroll() reads index 0 of UsedBankrollAddresses as the transfer destination.
WithdrawAndTransferToBankroll() forwards to the ZethrInterface.withdraw entry point.
RequestBankrollPayment() calls ZethrTierLibrary.getTier(userDivRate).
RequestBankrollPayment() stores the getTier result into the local tier variable.
getTier returns the tier index that becomes RequestBankrollPayment.tier.
RequestBankrollPayment() assigns UsedBankrollAddresses[tier] to tokenBankrollAddress.
tokenBankrollAddress is read out of the UsedBankrollAddresses state array.
RequestBankrollPayment() makes an external call to the tier token bankroll, which can execute arbitrary code before returning.
The token bankroll/token contract can call back into Zethroll.execute during gameRequestTokens, re-entering the roll entry point.
_finishBet() triggers the external gameRequestTokens call while settling a winning bet.
Re-entrancy path reaches _playerRollDice again through execute() before the external call returns.
execute() is guarded by the fromBankroll modifier before any state change.
fromBankroll validates ValidBankrollAddress[msg.sender], an attacker-controlled value.
fromBankroll reads the ValidBankrollAddress whitelist mapping.
execute() calls _playerRollDice(chosenNumber, _tkn, userDivRate).
execute() passes its _from argument as the settlement target.
execute() decodes chosenNumber from _data[0].
chosenNumber flows into _playerRollDice as the roll-under value.
_playerRollDice is guarded by the betIsValid modifier.
_playerRollDice is guarded by the gameIsActive modifier.
gameIsActive reads the gamePaused state flag.
betIsValid compares _betSize against the minBet state variable.
betIsValid calls calculateProfit to bound the potential payout.
betIsValid calls getMaxProfit for the profit comparison.
_playerRollDice writes the playerRoll struct into playerRolls[_tkn.sender].
_playerRollDice increments the global bet counters without SafeMath.
totalBets += 1 mutates the totalBets state variable.
totalZTHWagered += _tkn.value mutates the totalZTHWagered state variable.
_playerRollDice calls _finishBet to settle an existing roll before starting a new one.
finishBet() delegates settlement to _finishBet(msg.sender).
finishBet() uses msg.sender as the settlement target.
_finishBet reads and then zeroes the playerRolls[target] entry.
_finishBet calls random(100, roll.blockn, target) to determine the outcome.
random() wraps maxRandom(blockn, entropy).
maxRandom derives the outcome from blockhash and an entropy address, a predictable randomness source.
_finishBet calls calculateProfit for a winning roll.
calculateProfit performs raw multiplications that can overflow.
calculateProfit uses SafeMath.sub on _roll - 1.
_finishBet calls getMaxProfit(roll.divRate) to cap the payout.
getMaxProfit reads contractBalance[divRate].
getMaxProfit reads maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
_finishBet calls subContractBalance on a win.
subContractBalance uses SafeMath.sub.
subContractBalance writes contractBalance[divRate].
_finishBet calls addContractBalance on a loss.
addContractBalance uses SafeMath.add.
addContractBalance writes contractBalance[divRate].
_finishBet refreshes the tier max profit after settlement.
setMaxProfit writes maxProfit[divRate].
setMaxProfit reads contractBalance[divRate].
setMaxProfit reads maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
The constructor calls setupBankrollInterface(ZethrMainBankrollAddress).
The constructor supplies ZethrMainBankrollAddress to setupBankrollInterface.
setupBankrollInterface calls gameGetTokenBankrollList() on the main bankroll.
setupBankrollInterface assigns the returned list to UsedBankrollAddresses.
gameGetTokenBankrollList returns the address[7] list stored into UsedBankrollAddresses.
setupBankrollInterface whitelists each bankroll into ValidBankrollAddress.
The constructor calls ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse(10000).
The constructor calls ownerSetMinBet(1e18).
The constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
The constructor writes the owner state variable.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender to owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerSetMinBet is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerPauseGame is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerChangeOwner is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerkill is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerUpdateContractBalance is restricted by onlyOwner.
ownerkill executes selfdestruct(owner).
selfdestruct sends the remaining balance to the owner state variable.
ownerUpdateContractBalance writes contractBalance[divRate].
ownerUpdateContractBalance assigns newContractBalance into the ledger.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens is restricted by the fromBankroll modifier.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens writes contractBalance[divRate].
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens assigns newBalance into the ledger.
bankrollExternalUpdateTokens calls setMaxProfit(divRate) after updating the balance.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse writes maxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse stores newMaxProfitAsPercent into the state variable.
ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse refreshes maxProfit for all tiers via setMaxProfit.
ownerSetMinBet writes the minBet state variable.
ownerSetMinBet assigns newMinimumBet into minBet.
ownerPauseGame writes the gamePaused state variable.
ownerChangeOwner writes the owner state variable.
RequestBankrollPayment forwards the recipient parameter to the token bankroll.
RequestBankrollPayment forwards the token amount parameter to the token bankroll.
RequestBankrollPayment derives the tier from userDivRate.
_playerRollDice stores _rollUnder into the playerRoll struct.
_playerRollDice uses the TKN struct value and sender.
_playerRollDice stores userDivRate into the playerRoll struct.
execute copies _from into TKN.sender.
_finishBet reads playerRolls[target] and pays out to target.
_finishBet computes and caps the local profit variable.
RequestBankrollPayment invokes the gameRequestTokens interface function on the token bankroll.

normalization_plan.reason: The main bankroll address parameter only feeds setupBankrollInterface; collapse it into the initialiser.
The payment recipient parameter is only used by RequestBankrollPayment to build the external call.
The token amount parameter is only used by RequestBankrollPayment to build the external call.
The userDivRate parameter is only consumed inside RequestBankrollPayment for tier resolution.
The tier local is an intermediate value of RequestBankrollPayment's tier lookup.
The tokenBankrollAddress local is the destination of RequestBankrollPayment's external call.
The roll-under parameter is written into playerRolls within _playerRollDice.
The TKN struct parameter only carries bet value and sender into _playerRollDice.
The divRate parameter is stored into the playerRoll struct inside _playerRollDice.
The _from parameter is consumed by execute to populate TKN.sender.
The chosenNumber local is decoded and immediately passed to _playerRollDice from execute.
The target parameter only indexes playerRolls inside _finishBet.
The profit local is computed, capped and forwarded by _finishBet's payout path.
The newMinimumBet parameter is directly assigned to minBet by ownerSetMinBet.
The newMaxProfitAsPercent parameter is validated and assigned by ownerSetMaxProfitAsPercentOfHouse.
The newContractBalance parameter is written into contractBalance by ownerUpdateContractBalance.
The newBalance parameter is written into contractBalance by bankrollExternalUpdateTokens.
